title: docs(notes): agent-consumption benchmark — 3-round cold-start A/B (anonymized)
docs(spec): agent-consumption optim — strip decision-history in agent view, ask slices, hybrid-drilldown resident, README positioning
feat(section,mcp): agent view strips decision-history materialization — read thick pages without burning journal
why:
R1 of the benchmark cost more via wiki (102k>83k) because agentView kept
the decision-history sentinel region (tens of KB). view=agent now strips
it too, leaving a pointer line; decision history is fetched on demand via
section=Decision history.

title: feat(ask): CLI returns section slices, not just paths — found page = answer in hand
why:
The wiki group burned tokens doing ask.js (path only) then Read whole page.
CLI now prints the matched section's slice (with its func@file anchors)
inline; --paths keeps the old path-only output for scripts.

title: feat(resident): hybrid drilldown — wiki builds frame, func@file anchors drill to source, decision-history on demand
docs(readme): when-to-use positioning — lore is an anchored navigation layer, advantage scales with repo size
docs(spec): prompt-hook — three consumption tiers (soft default / notice / inject), opt-in UserPromptSubmit
feat(lorehook): three-tier consumption hook (soft default / notice / inject) — opt-in UserPromptSubmit
why:
CLAUDE.md resident is session-level and gets diluted in long chats.
UserPromptSubmit hook runs every turn (harness-enforced). notice tier
injects the hybrid-paradigm reminder each turn; inject tier gates on
code-question keywords and injects lore_ask section slices. Soft tier
(default, no hook) unchanged. install writes .claude/settings.local.json
(per-machine), --project for shared.

title: docs(readme): lorehook three-tier table + ignore settings.local.json
feat(shell,sync): 「✏️ 重写这页」instruction-carrying button + rename mechanical chips to 同步/补
why:
Separates the two concepts in the UI: mechanical chips (stale/缺图/缺档)
are 排队同步 (no instruction, chase code/fill structure); the new
「重写这页」button (every non-docs page, not just stale) prompts for a
free-text instruction → queue carries it → axisPrompt injects it →
runner/sync rewrites by your intent. sync.md teaches session consumption.

title: feat(server): rewrite-requests POST passes through instruction (truncated 500)
feat(runner): instruction flows queue→page→axisPrompt — rewrite carries user intent
feat(syncstate): rewrite-request carries optional instruction — sync (no-instr) dedupes, rewrite (instr) updates in place
docs(spec): separate queue-sync from rewrite-improve — instruction-carrying rewrite
feat(lint,manifest,shell): two-tier quality gate — deep pages missing 机制详解 become visible
why:
Companion to missing-diagram. Deep pages (config deep submodules) must
have both tiers; manifest flags hasMechanism, shell shows 「📖 缺机制详解」
clickable chip, lint reports missing-mechanism. Birdseye pages (overview
only) and theme/flow (single-tier) are not checked — respects lore's
layered page standard.

title: feat(lint,manifest,shell): missing-diagram quality gate — component/flow 缺架构图变可见
why:
sync 的架构图是执行 agent 写的、会漏（jpm 6 页全漏，浏览才发现）。
机械部分可靠、创造性部分不设防是真短板。现在 manifest 给 component/flow
页标 hasDiagram，缺图时壳显示「🖼 缺架构图·点击排队重写」徽标、lint 报
missing-diagram。质量问题从默默接受变成一眼可见。

title: feat(migrate): docs-axis gap-fill uses discoverDocs real glob (not comment default)
why:
The migrate gap jpm-ysqy hit: a repo init'd before docs auto-discovery
never gets a working docs axis — alignConfig only added a commented-out
template. Now when a repo has a dedicated docs dir, finalize/migrate fills
a usable docs_glob + sources automatically. Engine upgrades reach old
repos on the next finalize.

title: fix(init): exclude third-party dirs (addons/Pods/Assets...) from doc discovery, prefer docs/
why:
jpm-ysqy (Godot) has addons/godot_mcp/*.md — those are plugin docs, not
the repo's. discoverDocs now excludes common third-party dirs and sorts
docs/-named dirs first (renderConfigYaml takes [0]).

title: fix(portal,init): portal hot-reloads registry + discoverDocs skips root-scattered md
why:
portal: createPortalServer now accepts a function (re-reads registry per
request) so newly /lore:init'd repos appear without restarting portal —
the startup-snapshot bug jpm-ysqy hit. discoverDocs: root-level scattered
.md (CHANGELOG/README in code/game repos) no longer makes the whole repo
a docs glob (**/*.md); it drills to the dedicated docs/ subdir.

title: docs(notes): benchmark round 2 — post-optimization re-test, wiki chain -43% (R1 reversed, 0 full-page reads)
